<h1>Step Duty</h1>

## Purpose

Edit the per-step **duty cycle** (note length) of the selected sequencer.
Each of the 16 steps stores a value 1–8, and that value indexes the
sequencer's own duty curve, which picks one of 16 fixed note lengths.
On the default curve the eight rows are:

| Row and value | Note length |
|---|---|
| 1 (bottom) | `1/64` (0.25× a step) |
| 2 | `1/32` (0.5×) |
| 3 | `1/16T` (0.667×) |
| 4 | `1/32.` (0.75×) |
| 5 | `1/16` (1.0×: one whole step, the identity) |
| 6 | `1/8T` (1.333×) |
| 7 | `1/16.` (1.5×) |
| 8 (top) | `1/8` (2.0×) |

The curve is per-sequencer and editable, so a row can be pointed at any of
the 16 note lengths, up to `1/1` (see [Arp curves](/documentation/MSEQ/arp-curves)).

The sequencer's duty arp then lengthens or shortens the step's note, one
note length at a time: an arp value of 5 plays the step's length unchanged,
each value above 5 one length longer and each value below 5 one shorter,
stopping at `1/64` and `1/1` (see [Velocity and duty arps](/documentation/MSEQ/velo-duty-arps)).

## Interaction

Columns are steps (LHS = 1–8, RHS = 9–16), rows are values (row 1 bottom =
1 … row 8 top = 8). Each step lights a **single pad** at the height of its
stored value, not a bar filled from the bottom; a positioner colour marks
the playing step, and columns where a row plays a trig (a stored trig or a
Euclidean hit) are shaded slate behind the contour. Values and shading both
follow the sequencer's rotation. Pressing a pad writes that row's value to that step
instantly. No modifier needed.

## Shortcuts

| Gesture | Where | Action | Modifiers |
|---|---|---|---|
| Press | <span class="cell-label">Where</span> LP grid | <span class="cell-label">Action</span> Set the step (column) to the pressed row's duty | <span class="cell-label">Modifiers</span> none |
| SHIFT + MUTE + press row R | <span class="cell-label">Where</span> LP grid | <span class="cell-label">Action</span> **Reset**: all 16 steps → value of row R | <span class="cell-label">Modifiers</span> shift+mute |
| SHIFT + MUTE + press | <span class="cell-label">Where</span> LHS LP col 9 | <span class="cell-label">Action</span> **Reset**: all 16 steps → `6` (row 6, `1/8T` on the default curve) | <span class="cell-label">Modifiers</span> shift+mute |
| SHIFT + SOLO + press row R | <span class="cell-label">Where</span> LP grid | <span class="cell-label">Action</span> **Randomise**: all 16 steps gaussian around row R (clamped to rows 1–8) | <span class="cell-label">Modifiers</span> shift+solo |
| SHIFT + SOLO + press | <span class="cell-label">Where</span> LHS LP col 9 | <span class="cell-label">Action</span> **Randomise**: all 16 steps uniform random across values 1–8 | <span class="cell-label">Modifiers</span> shift+solo |
| Row-mode gestures | <span class="cell-label">Where</span> Row mutes | <span class="cell-label">Action</span> Row play-mode controls still apply (see "Row mode" in [Trig view reference](/documentation/MSEQ/views/trig)) | <span class="cell-label">Modifiers</span> any |
